title: Photosynthesis
summary: Photosynthesis turns light, water and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen.

key_concepts.explanation: The green pigment that absorbs light energy.
The reactions that build sugar from carbon dioxide.

outline.heading: Light reactions
points: They happen in the thylakoid membranes.

outline.heading: Calvin cycle
points: It takes place in the stroma.
It uses the ATP from the light reactions.
